title: Which Fairy Tale Role Are You?
description: Once upon a time, there was someone exactly like you. Find your place in the story!

questions.text: A friend calls with a big problem. You:

answers.text: Say 'I'm on my way' before they finish
Quietly fix it before they even ask twice
Ask the question that helps them solve it themselves
Show up with snacks and unwavering moral support

questions.text: Your ideal role at a wedding:

answers.text: Whatever job involves lifting, driving, or rescuing
The one who secretly paid for the band
Best friend duty: speeches, tears, dance floor
Effortlessly elegant guest everyone photographs

questions.text: Pick a gift to give at a christening (fairy tale style):

answers.text: Exactly what they'll need, right when they need it
A book with the important pages marked
A lifelong promise to always show up
Something beautiful that becomes an heirloom
Challenge it, openly, today
Quietly help the people it hurts
Explain patiently why it must change
Change it from the inside, with grace

questions.text: Your reaction to an unfair rule:

answers.text: First into the unknown
The one with the wisdom and the map
Morale, loyalty, and excellent commentary
Somehow never gets mud on their shoes
Prefer to learn by doing, occasionally the hard way
You give it wrapped in kindness and cake
You give it in riddles that make sense later
You mostly just listen, which is better anyway
Face it head-on
Know a guy. The dragon owes you a favor.
Recall that dragons respond well to riddles
Negotiate. Dragons respect composure.

questions.text: A dragon is (metaphorically) blocking the road. You:

answers.text: The next adventure on the horizon
Someone you taught surpassing you
Everyone you love in one room, laughing
A legacy that outlasts you, beautifully kept
Showing up when it was hard
Generosity they never saw coming
Being there through absolutely everything
Making everything feel special

questions.text: What do people thank you for most?

answers.text: A wand that only works for others' wishes
A lantern that lights the right path
A compass that points to your best friend
A crown that fits perfectly. Naturally.

results.description: Quietly magical and endlessly generous. You make wonderful things happen for people, often before they know they need it — and you never wait around for credit.
Brave heart, forward motion. When the story needs someone to step up, it's always you — not because it's easy, but because someone has to, and you love them.
The keeper of lanterns and good questions. You've seen enough of the story to guide others through it, and your advice always makes sense — eventually.
Grace under pressure and a touch of destiny. You carry yourself like the story was written about you — because honestly, it might have been.
The heart of the whole tale. Heroes get statues, but you get something better: everyone's trust, everyone's laughter, and a seat at every table forever.
